lines.say: Will a week off kill your gains?
Why does this happen, number nineteen.
Miss a week, and it feels like you're shrinking. Your muscles look flatter, and the pump is gone.
That's mostly less water and glycogen in your muscles, not lost muscle.
Studies show strength holds for about three weeks without training, and muscle loss is small at first.
In one study, people who took three-week breaks grew about as much over six months as people who never stopped.
Muscle memory helps too. Any size you lose comes back faster than it took to build.
So take the holiday. Just start a little lighter when you return.
